1879060660.name: Thrill of Danger
1879060660.desc: Regenerates Power, increasing with every enemy near you.\n(This skill works in combat only.)

1879064372.name: Swift Bow
1879064372.desc: Loose two missiles in rapid succession.

1879073716.name: Default Melee Attack
1879073716.desc: Auto-attack when wielding a one-handed weapon with a shield.

1879090228.name: Rampage
1879090228.desc: Get angry. Hit harder. Hit faster.

1879093044.name: Track Artifacts
1879093044.desc: When active, nearby artifacts are displayed on the radar.

1879102772.name: Tactics Signal
1879102772.desc: Extends Tactics fellowship skill bonus to your fellowship.

1879139380.name: Ferocious Strike
1879139380.desc: You make two ferocious attacks, building Fervour and removing Corruptions from your target upon criticals.

1879159988.name: Prized Tame Redhorn-goat
1879159988.desc: The Iron Garrison Miners have been training Redhorn mountain-goats to use as mounts.  These sure-footed creatures can traverse the rocky passageways of Moria where no horse could go.  This is one of their tame goats, making it not as fast as others.

1879215028.name: Poor Map to Tírith Rhaw
1879215028.desc: A poorly drawn and undetailed map to Tírith Rhaw.

1879215540.name: Improved Sure Strike
1879215540.desc: A melee attack that cannot be blocked or parried.\n\nReduces the active cooldown of Battle-shout.

1879221556.name: Cry of the Chorus (Resonance)
1879221556.desc: This skill provides you with three healing ballad bonus effects allowing access to Anthems and Codas. It also breaks any silence effects on you.

1879222196.name: Good Map to Tol Ascarnen
1879222196.desc: A well drawn and detailed map to Tol Ascarnen.

1879231412.name: Ranged Combination Strike
1879231412.desc: An aggressive weapon strike.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879245620.name: Oration of the Bleak Sky
1879245620.desc: A quick reflection on the power of words yields a damaging or inspiring effect to the Rune-keeper's enemies or allies.

1879245748.name: Sudden Diversion
1879245748.desc: Divert the enemy's attention and enter Combat Stealth.

1879254068.name: Strategic Strike
1879254068.desc: Enhanced damage when striking the target from behind. The Burglar targets a vital location and deals a significant amount of damage to their target.

1879266868.name: Discipline: Red Dawn
1879266868.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Red Dawn</rgb>

The Red Dawn Discipline turns your focus to that of the relentless warrior. Damage is improved and your focus is only to force your enemies to yield on the field of battle.

1879322036.name: Bear Up
1879322036.desc: Even in the darkest times, you give your allies hope.

1879344564.name: Golden Dragon Kite
1879344564.desc: Brings out a golden dragon kite for you to fly!

1879380148.name: Lost in Wistmead
1879380148.desc: Someone will come get you if you are lost.

1879403700.name: Drop Torch
1879403700.desc: Discard the torch and set it on the ground.

1879411764.name: Wild Cinnamon Donkey
1879411764.desc: Summons a loveable wild donkey travelling companion.

1879412020.name: Boar of the Three Peaks
1879412020.desc: This boar appears to be a hardy War of Three Peaks veteran.

1879440180.name: Crystal Spider
1879440180.desc: Summons a small crystal spider to keep you company.

1879469748.name: Rummage: Salts
1879469748.desc: A small phial of incredibly volatile salts from distant shores.

1879480628.name: Deep Emerald Snake
1879480628.desc: Summons a snake to accompany you on your travels.

1879486004.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Temamir Guard)
1879486004.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879491508.name: Muster at Urmâkh
1879491508.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Urmâkh in Imhûlar in the Ikorbân Valley.

1879529268.name: Drop the Visage of Gil-galad
1879529268.desc: Drop the Visage of Gil-galad relic.

1879529524.name: Golden Doe
1879529524.desc: Summons a golden doe to accompany you on your travels.
